description: Read your blueprint's task list (mission control) by its instance_id (bpr_..., in list_utilities): every task with its status and blocked_by, the progress your human sees on plan_url, the current phase and next_task (a task in progress, else the first unblocked open task). Until the tasks stage is saved, ready is false and next names the stage to save. If stale is true, save stale_stage again first. Set statuses with blueprint_update_task. Readable after the plan ended too.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: blueprint_tasks
title: List blueprint tasks
